title: JobRadar candidate facts
description: Who the candidate is, read from a CV and confirmed by the candidate. Facts only: how to search and score (keywords, signals, context words) is tuned against the market and lives in the matching profiles. A profile draft is derived from these facts.

type.description: working_holiday: ads that need citizenship, PR or unlimited work rights are out (the score rules already do this).

wanted.description: Wants the 88 days of specified work: a regional target makes sense.

location.description: Seek location label, e.g. "Perth WA". Default search location for targets.

fifo.description: Would fly in, fly out from the base.

relocate.description: Other Seek locations the candidate would move to.

education.description: Formal training. What is not recognised in Australia does not count as a trade or degree: ads that ask for one get the qualification penalty.

title.description: As on the CV, in its own language.

recognisedInAustralia.description: Assessed or held as an Australian qualification (Cert III, licence to practise). false when unknown: an overseas certificate is not a trade ticket by itself.

fullFrom.description: When a provisional licence becomes full.

heavy.description: Heavy vehicle classes held (Australian names). Every class not held penalises ads that require it.

tickets.description: Short-course tickets and trade licences. held: no penalty; obtainable: a small one (the candidate would take the course); outOfReach: a qualification penalty.

obtainable.description: Would take the course, e.g. "HRWL", "forklift", "white card".

experience.description: Work history by area. Years in an area below what an ad asks for is the experience penalty; senior level allows senior titles.

role.description: In English, as an Australian ad would title it.

skills.description: Tools and techniques as ads write them: candidates for positive signals.

targets.description: Lines of work the candidate wants. Each one is a matching profile.

profile.description: Profile name. Keep the name of an existing profile: scores are stored by it.

roles.description: Job titles to search for: candidates for keywords.

experienceAreas.description: Which experience areas count for this target.

locations.description: Seek locations to search. Default: the base location.

excludedLocations.description: E.g. "Perth WA" for the 88 days, which do not count there.

entryLevel.description: Rewards "no experience required" and the like.

workFromHome.description: Remote means working from home here, not a remote site.

avoid.description: What the candidate does not want, as ads write it: candidates for negative signals.

openQuestions.description: What the CV did not say and the candidate has not answered yet.
